operations.body: The locally positive Bunch-Davies sheet has trivial stabilizer and a 32-element regular deck orbit. Restrictions glue with 2^(5-|B|) classes on branch stratum B. The orbit trace is invariant, but the physical chamber vector is not; physical evaluation is a sector-specific local readout rather than invariant-cycle descent.

operations.title: Benincasa separates physical sheet equivariance from invariant descent
operations.body: Entry 1224 corrects the remaining physical-cycle gate. Gamma_+ should not descend as one invariant cycle: it has trivial stabilizer and spans the regular 32-sheet orbit. The trace is invariant, while the physical observable evaluates the source-selected local chamber vector. Branch restrictions glue canonically with 2^(5-|B|) classes. Thus the surviving cosmological datum is a sector-specific Betti local system/readout on the existing cover, not a carrier defect. Next gate is covariance of the coefficient–Betti pairing under joint continuation.
